name: universal-official-skills
description: Official software guidance, existing-code inspection, reuse and upgrade proposals, and edits only after explicit approval. Portable skills-only workflow.

defaultPrompt: Check official guidance and existing code. Propose reuse or exact changes, then wait for my approval before editing.
interface.longDescription: For software questions and implementation planning across products, SDKs, frameworks, and languages. Consult relevant official vendor skills and version-matched documentation, inspect accessible code for existing functionality, and recommend reuse, configuration, or upgrades before proposing new code. Present exact changes and wait for approval before editing; provide manual steps without approval. Includes pinned catalogs for ServiceNow, OpenAI, Microsoft, and Anthropic, with explicitly labeled official documentation/source fallback for other products. Requires host-provided source reading and authorized code access. This independently authored skills-only plugin supplies instructions, not runtime tools, permission enforcement, or security scanning. It cannot verify inaccessible code or guarantee coverage of every vendor.

publication.release_notes: Adds the Universal AI Skills logo, composer icon, and public listing metadata.
